current_answer: At about 19:04 UTC on October 14, 2026, Kalshi’s October Chance headings showed 69% “Fed maintains rate” and 31% “Hike 25bps”; Polymarket’s separate named rows showed 69% “No change” and 31% “25 bps increase.” Both venues again favored a hold for the October 27–28 FOMC meeting. Since the about 13:34 UTC checks, Kalshi’s hold heading rose 16 percentage points and its hike heading fell 16; Polymarket’s no-change row rose 22 points and its hike row fell 21. The Fed published its October Beige Book at 14:00 ET (18:00 UTC), reporting little or no employment change in most Districts and moderate or robust price growth in 11 of 12. These checks bracket the release but do not show that it caused the reversal. BLS September PPI is scheduled for October 15 at 08:30 ET (12:30 UTC).
